github_commits_by_type: Commits per month by repository type

Source: R/github_commits_by_type.R
github_commits_by_type.Rd

Monthly number of commits on the default branches, split by the type of the repository. One row per organisation, visibility, repository type and month in which the repositories of that type had at least one commit by a person, a bot or an automated push. The table holds counts only. It has no row per repository and no information about who made a commit. Private repositories are counted and never named.

Usage

github_commits_by_type

Format

A tibble with 9 variables

organisation

Login of the GitHub organisation.

visibility

Visibility of the repositories on the snapshot date. Levels: public, private.

repository_type

Type of the repositories, see github_repository_types for the levels and the rules.

month

First day of the month (UTC) in which the commits were authored.

commits

Number of commits made by people on the default branches, without merge commits, commits by bots and automated commits. Forks are not counted.

commits_bot

Number of commits authored by bot accounts and by GitHub Actions. Not part of commits.

commits_automated

Number of commits pushed by a device or a script under the account of a person. Not part of commits. See github_commits.

commits_assisted

Number of commits counted in commits whose message carries a trailer of a coding agent. A lower bound, since the trailer is optional.

repos_active

Number of repositories of that type with at least one commit by a person in that month.

Source

GitHub REST API, read with data-raw/data_processing_github.R.

Details

The columns commits, commits_bot, commits_automated and commits_assisted add up to the columns of the same name in github_commits for every organisation, visibility and month. Merge commits and forks are left out. The types are the ones of github_repository_types, which describes the rules. The type is the type on the snapshot date in github_organisations.
